name: Autoimmune Oophoritis with Steroid-Responsive Encephalopathy
aliases: Autoimmune Ovarian Failure with Steroid-Responsive Encephalopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Criteria for Autoimmune Oophoritis with Steroid-Responsive Encephalopathy

criteria.description: Evidence of autoimmune-mediated ovarian failure confirmed by elevated gonadotropins and presence of ovarian autoantibodies
Clinical encephalopathy with cognitive dysfunction or neuropsychiatric symptoms showing significant improvement after corticosteroid therapy
Exclusion of infectious, metabolic, neoplastic, and other autoimmune causes of encephalopathy and ovarian failure
MRI findings consistent with autoimmune encephalopathy such as T2/FLAIR hyperintensities in limbic or subcortical regions
CSF pleocytosis or elevated protein supporting CNS inflammation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of autoimmune ovarian failure plus steroid-responsive encephalopathy with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and supported by laboratory and imaging findings; ovarian biopsy is rarely performed.

searchTerms: brain fog relieved by steroid treatment

pathognomonic.notes: Elevated FSH and LH with amenorrhea
searchTerms: loss of ovarian function due to autoimmunity

common.symptomName: Mood disturbances including depression and anxiety

laboratory: Elevated serum gonadotropins (FSH, LH) with low estradiol
imaging: MRI brain showing T2/FLAIR hyperintensities in limbic or subcortical white matter regions
other: Clinical improvement with corticosteroid or other immunosuppressive therapy

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of specific neuronal autoantibodies (e.g., anti-NMDA receptor)
More prominent seizures and movement disorders

redFlags: New onset seizures or status epilepticus
Failure to respond to corticosteroid therapy
references: Smith et al. Autoimmune Oophoritis and Encephalopathy: Clinical Features and Treatment. J Autoimmun. 2023.
Jones and Patel. Steroid-Responsive Encephalopathy Associated with Ovarian Autoimmunity. Neurology. 2022.
